name: voice-edge-auth-sync
description: Syncs browser authentication and conversation state for Voice Edge (single source, builds Firefox MV2 + Chrome MV3)

scripts.package:source: tar --exclude='dist' --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.DS_Store' -czf voice-edge-auth-sync-source.tar.gz src manifest.base.json manifest.firefox.json manifest.chrome.json build.mjs package.json README.md .github bin
scripts.release: tag=${npm_config_tag:?Usage: npm run release --tag=vx.y.z}; git tag "$tag" && git push origin "$tag"
